12294:# Veilcast

Private prediction markets on Starknet. Visible odds, invisible bettors.

> Built for the STRK20 Private Sprint, against the live STRK20 privacy pool.

## What it is

Veilcast is a predict
summary: Place anonymous bets on prediction markets with visible odds.
description_long: Veilcast creates a prediction market where the details of bets stay private while odds and volumes are public. It consists of a market contract that tracks per-outcome volumes and public keys, while identity privacy is maintained through a rotating relayer that records transactions. Bets are made by depositing STRK into the pool, generating a fresh keypair for each bet, and payouts are handled through private note transfers, ensuring anonymity for bettors.

assessment.reason: Veilcast enables private bettors to participate in public prediction markets.
